_source: Issue #33 debug log (home-assistant_tineco_2026-07-12T20-59-01.454Z.log), Floor One S5 Combo, region IE/FR, integration v2.4.2, HA 2026.7.2.
_regression_note: The Floor One S5 Combo has no floor brush light hardware, so its gci payload never contains the 'led' field: ['cds', 'wm', 'scm', 'cnv', 'scs', 'smr', 'sr', 'dv', 'bp', 'bc', 'msr', 'vl', 'vs', 'e', 'cc']. The cloud API nonetheless accepts {'led': 0} and replies with a success payload, so the switch appeared to work while doing nothing (issue #33). The switch platform must not create the Floor Brush Light entity for this payload shape. Note this model also reports errors via a single 'e' field rather than e1/e2/e3, and battery as bp=240 (fully charged).
